notes.title: Episode 2 Out Now!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41960181/5839def73587470e789755fb4a1474342d4f4c83.png[/img]
[h1]Episode 2[/h1]
[h2]A Night in Hallon[/h2]
[i]Nyx and her team head out from the capital on their journey to Thalmia, and her new squad mates quickly start butting heads. After a close call in the forest, they stop for the night at the small village of Hallon, where their hosts make them feel extra welcome...[/i]

[h1]At long last, Episode 2 is out![/h1]
We pushed the initial update minutes before midnight hit on the 30th, and a few hotfixes since then, but the game is now officialy out and working for (hopefully) all players!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41960181/68ef6c5088e843c014b6c9a7d9cb8acb1d2aa214.png[/img]
[b]Some quick notes:[/b]
- If you previously opted into the beta, you'll need to opt out of it and back to the main branch before the update will become available (we know, we're working on fixing that). 
- If the game gives you an error about being unable to find the correct file path, or doesn't seem to update, go into the Properties, then into Installed Files, then click on "Verify integrity of game files".

If for some reason it still doesn't work, [url=https://discord.com/invite/PcCAhEmnDN]please contact us via Discord[/url] and we'll do our best to get things sorted!

[h2]The journey here was a long one.[/h2]
A very.... very long one. Obviously it's not how we planned on things going. There are a lot of reasons for it:
[list]
[*] Time mismanagement
[*] Underestimating how long certain tasks take (posing and rigging of additional Live2D sprites)
[*] Tools that worked for scenes in episode 1 that started to seriously lag with the additional complexity of scenes in episode 2
[*] Scope creep, dissatisfaction with the visuals
[/list]
A lot of reasons. [b]But no excuses.[/b]
Now, we have a much better idea of what to expect going into Episode 3. 

Such as the fact that a single 9 character scene takes as much time as eight 2 character scenes... (The final scene looks great, but absolutely not worth the stress and delay it caused.) It didn't help that we added a lot more "sprite animation" into the game, which just exacerbated the issue.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41960181/0ca6a3a6114db8a52fa670be11cab1e8f256bd6e.png[/img]
Speaking of... the more complex scenes in Episode 2 caused a LOT of issues with how we were laying out and designing the scenes. The scenes are all layed out and roughly animated in After Effects, before being transferred to code, which worked great in Episode 1... but once the scenes got more complex, the lag it started generating started to become a real problem (losing 60+ seconds every time you save doesn't sound like much, but it can drive a man insane...) 

In fact, it got so bad that we wound up building some tools these past couple of months to help speed up the scene posing, and have some rough concepts of additional workflow tools to speed things up. We haven't FULLY gotten away from After Effects yet, but with a bit more development on these tools, we'll get 99% of the way there. We'll post more about these tools and behind the scenes stuff soon.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41960181/48e8a068611297a0c5b1d7e8230344f42d06316d.png[/img]
If we'd decided to go with the standard "one character on the left, one on the right" format of visual novels, we wouldn't have any of these problems... but we didn't. That's not what we wanted for Vaygren. From the beginning, we always wanted Vaygren LT to feel as much like watching an anime as possible, and to pull that off that means A LOT of custom code, custom tools, and figuring out how to work with the limited assets we have to pull off the look we want. 

We're not a big studio. It's just been the two of us doing the bulk of the work, and our skillsets don't crossover much. We're fixing some of that going forward (hiring additional help, etc), but this game remains a passion project for the two of us at the core of Cyberframe. This is the game we want to make, and we're gonna make it.

And to that end, while we aren't happy about how long it took... we are happy with what we've made.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41960181/8299535fd25773b0a96ae72b5c3293327a63e0d1.png[/img]
We'll be taking the next week or so to get things in order for Episode 3, figuring out how to improve some of our workflow and tools (expect a post elaborating on all of that!), and in general getting things ready so that the wait for Episode 3 will be a much, much shorter affair. 

Our development livestreams will be resuming in the next week or so, and we are excited to move on from Episode 2 and finally put our full focus on Episode 3! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41960181/c5f43a9ddf6157d9618e8d130e73a06a62072c3c.png[/img]

[h2]Now that that's out of the way...[/h2]
What are you still doing here? Get that game updated and enjoy!

notes.title: Progress Update
notes.content:
A little birdy told us that maybe we should've provided some more info on the progress of Episode 2… and yeah, fair, we should have.

[b]And so, a word from our programmer:[/b]

Hello! Aebard here. (It's actually always me, but now I'm speaking as me, not as the combined entity that is Cyberframe). I'm the big hold up on the release of Episode 2, and the one that kept providing (extremely inaccurate) estimations on release dates. 

Firstly, I'm extremely sorry for hold up, and flat out wrong time estimations. At the time, I really thought they were going to be accurate… even up to the hours leading up to the deadlines. I know that seems insane, considering how much longer it has been, but it's still true. I wish I'd had a better handle on the time things would take (and still do), because the last thing we want is to let people down. Even so, that's what happened, and that's on me. 

I haven't given a new updated estimated date because, again, I just can't trust my own sense of how long things will take yet. That said, I really don't want to leave people hanging, so here's the next best thing.

Here's the overall progress of Episode 2 (as of 2/19). I'll be updating this daily as I finish up work on the game.  ([url=https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/u/5/d/e/2PACX-1vRW6ah63DZ9QRUkQ0FfqIG7zEj0asO60Fn0drqSanbbHi3YEARlWr24DE4P0WX2Of1dPnSm5EXkIOZM/pubchart?oid=1276974533&format=interactive]Follow this link to see the current status[/url])

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41960181/727006ac5a4b015d97a1cdd502f6e635a53b9490.png[/img]

As you can see, the last big hold out is scene posing. I've spoken about this briefly in some previous posts and on discord, but this is by far the most time consuming part of creating LT, and it's what gives the game it's specific look and feel. 

[b]But why is it taking so long? [/b]
There are a couple reasons, which I'll briefly explain here. 
Please don't take any of this as excuses. I still should've managed it better. This is just to give some insight into how I could heck up the estimations so badly.

The biggest thing was that I'd been using Episode 1 as the gauge for how long things would take. The posing in Episode 1, while time consuming, was actually very simple in composition: mostly simple back and forth shots between two characters. The majority of Episode 2, however, features three or more characters on screen, all of which need to move and pose on screen, interacting, with camera shots that make logical sense, etc… and all that turned out to be exponentially more time consuming than the back and forth shots of Episode 1. 

In a similar vein, Episode 1 is largely setting the stage and introducing characters. This makes it a little easier to transition between scenes, without things feeling too jarring. In Episode 2, we already know our main characters, and now we're traveling with them through the world, scenes leading one into another, and "fade to black" just doesn't cut it most of the time. 

Then there's Live2D. Live2D is awesome. It's what allows us to give the characters so many poses and expressions, instead of just 3 or 4, and what lets us animate them. However, Live2D is incredibly time consuming to setup & create the characters. Episode 2 requires 4 new characters (and some change, some of the CGs use Live2D), as well as modifying the current characters to support specific motions and poses that they couldn't in Episode 1. All that wound up eating up a few months of development. 

Which leads us to the posing. The primary issue with this is… After Effects. For those of you who know Ren'py (the game engine we use), you'll know that it's all code, with no visual editor. This means that all scenes have to be written out as code, trial and error style. Lustful Temptation would be impossible (or at least, look much worse), if we had to trial and error every shot. So, to streamline things, I wrote a tool that would let me layout the scenes, plan motions, and pose characters in After Effects, and then export that directly into code, which I can paste into the game. And it works great! Except… After Effects is notorious for being laggy, and the lag just gets worse the more complicated the shots become (and I suspect the Live2D plugin is also tanking the performance). Saving currently locks me out of the program for a full 40 seconds, which doesn't sound like a lot, but any After Effects veteran will let you know that the lag and save interruptions are enough to break a man.

There were other things here and there. Bug chasing, getting sick, stuff that worked during the first pass that just didn't hold up once we put all the posing and animations in, etc. Little, unexpected  things, but they add up. 

And finally, my own dang brain lying to me about how fast I can get things done. Even now, my gut tells me that I can complete the rest in an amount of time history has shown me is incorrect.

[b]And how are you going to make these aren't problems going forward?[/b]
This has been at the forefront of my mind this whole time, ever seine missing that first deadline. We've mentioned before about bringing on some more people to help with some of the tasks that I (as the programmer) don't need to be doing (art cleanup, Live2D, audio mastering, etc), and that's going to be a big help. I'll also be handing off some of the posing as well, splitting up that work load.

As to After Effects? These past months, as I've been cursing Adobe daily, I did figure out a way to build a tool to let me do the Live2D posing in-game, rather than having to go through After Effects. This won't eliminate After Effects from the process entirely (yet), as I'll still have to do the shot layout there,  but it will speed things up considerably. 

[b]And so, once again…[/b]
I'm terribly sorry for how long this episode has taken. It's not where I thought I'd be, and not what our players deserve. I appreciate everyone that's supported us, even with the delays and disappointment. 

So keep an eye on that chart, I'll be updating it everyday, getting those last percentages knocked out and closer to release. Episode 2 is looking fantastic, and I'm excited for everyone to see it… and doubly excited to start in on Episode 3. 

As always, I'm available [url=https://discord.com/invite/PcCAhEmnDN]on our discord[/url] and happy to talk about the game's development and answer any questions, and I'll keep an eye on the comments below!

notes.title: Vaygren Lore Q&A #2
notes.content:
It's time once again for another Vaygren Lore Q&A! 

But first, some updates. Obviously, the update still isn't out, but we are making steady progress, and getting a better grasp on how long some of these things take and where we can optimize our workflow going forward. Of course, it's all just talk until we do it, so back to the grindstone. 

Now, while we brace ourselves for the incoming comments...  Open your mind and take in the lore!

[h1]Vaygren Lore Q&A #2[/h1]
[i][b]Disclaimer:[/b] Until any of these answers appear in a game, animation, comic, etc, they are subject to change at our whim. [/i]

[b]Are there other monarchs in the world of Vaygren or is Alees the only one?[/b]
There are, though considerably less since Alees rose to power several decades ago…

[b]Is there a queen of the Elves or Dark Elves?[/b]
Well, Elves and Vaymen are the most common of races in Vaygren, and it's been a long, LONG time since the majority of Elves or Vaymen followed a specific ruler.

Dark Elves, on the other hand, are still mostly from one region, the Shadow Wastes, and though they don't currently have a specific ruler, most of them do see themselves as independent from the rest of the Vaygren races. At the moment, anyway.

[b]Who did Alees serve/service before she was in charge?[/b]
REDACTED

[b]Can beastkin change into their animal forms? Nekomata into cats, lizardkin into lizards, etc?[/b]
Technically, any sapient race in Vaygren can learn to use magic to shapeshift, though it's more difficult for non-beastkin to learn. Even so, just because they CAN learn to shapeshift, doesn't mean it's easy, and (with a few exceptions) they do have to put effort into learning the skill.

That said, SOME of the beastkin races do have innate shapeshifting abilities, like the Nekomata or Kitsune. When they achieve a certain level of magic, they gain the ability to shapeshift; however, if their tails are cut off, they lose this innate ability. They can re-learn to shapeshift via a spell, like any other race, but lose their innate ability to do so.

[b]How does one rank up in Alees army?[/b]
Despite the obvious rampant sexual corruption in the empire, ranking in the imperial army is still largely merit based. 

Alees has 12 generals that serve beneath her (heh), and each runs their division of the army differently. Some focus on strength and raw power, some on cunning, and others on seduction and stealth. Some soldiers might get promoted in return for sexual favors; however if they don't have the skills to keep those positions, they don't last very long.

[b]It seems that the army is quite lenient with the level of harassment they allow in their ranks. Is there a point where it can go too far and someone will step in?[/b]
It depends. As mentioned above, each of the twelve generals runs their division differently. Some of them have standards that they hold their underlings to, others… not so much. Some even encourage it, or push their soldiers to go further.

This can cause some strife between the different generals and their divisions. General Solara is known for being honorable and keeping a tight rein on her soldiers. She doesn't like to see her efforts wasted, so she makes sure her underlings don't cross any lines. That said, she and her soldiers are still part of the empire, and that comes with certain… liberties.

[b]Are there guilds/mercenaries/adventurers that take on missions / defeat monsters for money?[/b]
Absolutely! We don't see much of them in Vaygren LT, as the focus is on members of the imperial army, but there definitely are the more traditional fantasy adventurer types out there in the world!

[b]Are there magical / fight tournaments in Vaygren?[/b]
Absolutely! The gladiators are one of the main forms of entertainment for high society in the Empire. 

[b]Do they have any sports games and what do they play in Vaygren? Like football, basketball, baseball, volleyball?[/b]
They have a number of different sports, some even similar to ones we have on Earth, although none are exactly the same and have different names.

[b]Will there be a multiverse in Vaygren?[/b]
In the sense that Vaygren and Earth exists in different universes / dimensions, yes (and maybe others worlds exist). But as far as other universes where you can find different versions of the same character, then no.

That said, we might do some non-canon short stories or games with the Vaygren characters in different settings, for fun. Maybe a Vaygren Space Opera with space ship battles, or a 1920s noir detective story where Cassidy is a private eye. Could be fun.

---

That's it for now, back to cracking the whip on production.

As always, if you've got any questions you'd like to see answered, whether it's about game development or Vaygren lore, drop them in the comments below or [url=https://discord.com/invite/PcCAhEmnDN]shoot us a message on Discord[/url], and it might get mentioned in the next Q&A post!

The next Q&A will be about the game's development, so this is your chance to ask for some specifics about how we make the game, why exactly things take so darn long, etc... 

Back to the dev mines.

notes.title: Vaygren Development Q&A #2
notes.content:
[h2]So close, we can taste it.[/h2]

We know those words don't mean much, but nonetheless, we're leaps and bounds closer to releasing.

Obviously this is not where we thought we'd be. All we can say at this point is that we are still relatively new at this, and bound to make mistakes. Granted, this isn't a mistake we ourselves thought we'd make, but here we are. 

We've got things lined up so the same won't happen with Episode 3 (getting more people to split the work load, learning when to when to keep our mouths shut about release dates... etc). But first, we've gotta get Episode 2 out. No one wants the game out more than we do, and that's the truth.

And so, in the meantime, here's some more development Q&A!

[h1]Vaygren Development Q&A #2[/h1]

[b]Any plans on (main) character customization?[/b]
For future games, maybe, but not for Lustful Temptations. Any visual changes would pose a big challenge to making the sprites & CGs match up (not impossible, but a lot of work), and any changes such as name, etc, would require multiple takes of every voice line (again, not impossible, but a lot of work and a lot more assets to deal with). 

[b]What are some of the inspiration sources that went into this project?[/b]
Lot's and lots of hentai and anime from the 90s and early 2000s. [i]Angel Blade[/i], [i]La Blue Girl[/i], [i]Bible Black[/i], [i]The Slayers[/i], [i]Tenchi Muyo[/i], etc. We like new anime too, but those eras were the shows that really introduced us to anime, and still stick with us. 

[b]Do you guys already have an ending for LT?[/b]
Yeah, the entire game was written and planned out years ago. There are a few parts in some of the latter episodes that we want to expand on and slightly rework, but the majority of the story is the same as when we started.

[b]How were you guys so wrong on the release date?[/b]
Hubris. Overestimating how fast we can do things. Underestimating the amount of work. Lots of reasons that all combined to make this big mess, but the biggest mistake was announcing a release date before we really had a handle on how long production would take. 

[b]Are all 6 eps technically done in terms of early CG drafts, or did you decide to go Episode by Episode? [/b]
All the game CGs up until the final episode are at least rough sketched, many are basically finished (as far as the art goes, they still need some final cleanup and exported properly so the game can deal with eye blinks and lipflaps, etc). This also doesn't include any CGs that we decide are needed to smooth out the visual pacing of the game. 

[b]I know you used to have more comics and animations relating to Vaygren on gumroad. Will we be able to buy those again?[/b]
We are working on getting a new storefront up. We'll post an update on steam once the store launches, so people that are interested in more Vaygren content (comics, animations, etc) can check them out!

[b]Near the end of development, will you go back to previous episodes to rework and polish them?[/b]
Yes, in places where it makes sense. We already know at least 2 places in Episode 1 that we want to rework/improve, but that's low on the priority list right now.

[b]How much will our choices matter in later episodes?[/b]
Although your choices won't change the outcome of the overarching story, they WILLunlock additional scenes and events that Nyx will experience, focused on her relationships with her team.

[b]Is steam censoring the game in anyway?[/b]
Only in the sense that if you go to the game page while logged out, it looks like you've hit an error page because their age gate page just looks like an error >_<. We've gotten so many messages from people telling us that the steam page is broken. Please fix this steam.

But as for anything else, we already knew the general ground rules of what Steam would and wouldn't allow when we started planning the game, so we made sure the content would all be within Steam's limits of acceptability.

[b]Are you happy with how the game looks and plays currently?[/b]
Absolutely.
We love the look and feel of the game. Sometimes even we forget we're playing a game and feel like we're just watching an anime, and that really is the vibe we were shooting for.
The game is currently a bit more resource intensive than we'd like, though, so we are constantly trying to find ways to optimize things behind the scenes.

[b]How big will the game be at the end?[/b]
Each episodes is roughly the same length, give or take (it evens out between a few of them). So assuming players are actually reading the dialog, and depending on how fast you read/click… between 6 and 9 hours.

[b]Are you planning to have changes of perspective of events on the series? [/b]
Yes, but they will be very minor in the main game. We've tossed around the idea of doing some DLC after the main game is complete showing some events from the perspectives of other characters, but whether or not we end up deciding to do that is still up in the air.

[b]Are you guys planning on a sequel?[/b]
At the very least, we do plan on more games that take place in the world of Vaygren. Whether or not any of those will be a direct sequel remains to be seen.

[b]Will this upset my ancestors? [/b]
Well, that really depends on your ancestors… but probably.

---

That's it for now, so back to finishing Episode 2!

If you've got any questions you'd like to see answered, whether it's about game development or Vaygren lore, drop them in the comments below or [url=https://discord.com/invite/PcCAhEmnDN]shoot us a message on Discord[/url], and it might get mentioned in the next Q&A post!

As usual, back to the game dev mines.

notes.title: Vaygren Lore Q&A #1
notes.content:
We get a lot of questions about the Vaygren universe, so it's time for a Lore Q&A!

We're still working on Episode 2. Once it's all done (for sure) and we've uploaded it to steam for final checks, this is the first place we'll post about it. It's no substitute, we know, but here are some answers to your lore questions to hold you over!

[h1]Vaygren Lore Q&A #1[/h1]
[i][b]Disclaimer:[/b] Until any of these answers appear in a game, animation, comic, etc, they are subject to change at our whim. [/i]

[b]How many races exist within the Vaygren universe? [/b]
Lots! Between the game, animations, and random pinups, Vaygren has had/will have appearances from Vaymen, Elves/Dark Elves, Nekomata, Succubi, Lizardkin, Ogren, Oni, Devils, Kitsune, Naga, Inugami, and of course, the Vyrus.

There's more than just these though. Vaygren is a pretty diverse world!

Also there are humans, though they aren't native to the world.

[b]Will there be [insert fantasy race here]?[/b]
Maybe! If we feel like the race works within the world, we may include them, or at least a Vaygren-ized version of them.

[b]The Vyrus are super cool! Can you give us any more details on the vyrus race and any hints about the role they'll play going forward?[/b]
The Vyrus are the boogiemen (boogiewomen?) of the Vaygren universe. They are primarily creatures of instinct, impulse, and desire, unable to plan ahead and have no willpower to resist their own impulses. Coupled with their immense size, strength, libido, and endurance, this makes them a very dangerous foe. 

The only way to control vyrus is for a more powerful being to threaten them, as self-preservation is just as strong as the desire to fight or fuck (so long as they haven't worked themselves up into a frenzy). That said, vyrus are creatures of "the moment", so they will not obey orders for long if the source of their fear is not present.

This makes them extremely volatile and hard to control. As such, the vyrus legions are kept separate from the rest of the armies and away from the population.  To ensure they are kept in line, the empire makes sure they are kept... entertained. 

This isn't a foolproof plan, of course, and if not monitored carefully, the vyrus can work themselves up into a frenzy and go on rampages. In such a case, one of the empire's Generals would be dispatched to handle the situation. If the vyrus are too far gone and won't respond to the presence of a more powerful opponent, more drastic measures are taken.

Worse case, the entire group of vyrus would be eliminated. The empire is not too worried about this though... it's easy enough to make more.

[b]Can you tell us if the Vyrus are naturally occurring creatures? That is, are they something artificially created?[/b]
Well, actually [i][strike]REDACTED REDACTED REDACTED REDACTED REDACTED REDACTED REDACTED REDACTED REDACTED REDACTED REDACTED REDACTED REDACTED REDACTED REDACTED[/strike][/i]. I hope that clears things up.

[b]Since the entire world of Vaygren is composed only of women, how are children conceived?[/b]
The exact mechanics of how it all works in Vaygren are a bit esoteric, and have a large spiritual component to them. Both intercourse and insemination via a dick (you can't just squirt it up in there with a turkey baster) are required to conceive a child, but they aren't the ONLY requirements. Additionally, [strike][i]REDACTED REDACTED REDACTED REDACTED REDACTED REDACTED REDACTED REDACTED[/i][/strike]. 

[b]Can different races reproduce with each other, and if so, what race would their offspring be? [/b]
They can indeed! Any non-sterile, sapient race can conceive with any other. The child will almost always be of the mother's race, but there's still a chance the child will inherit her sire's race. Circumstances around the conception can also shift this one way or another.

The physical appearance of the child will be a mixture of non-racial specific features. ex, the Nekomata child of a Nekomata and a Lizardkin (birthed by the Nekomata), will never have scales, but other features (eye color, face shape, etc) will be a mix/blend of the parents'.

[b]How do animals reproduce in Vaygren?[/b]
Same way the sapient races do, although they can't cast the spells to grow a dick at will. That said, they don't usually need to, due to how "natural" dickening works.

[b]Why are there no men in the world of Vaygren? Just curious about the creative decision.[/b]
As mentioned in the last Q&A… Cyberunique doesn't like drawing balls. 
That's why Vaygren is a female-only world. It's grown a bit beyond that, but that's the initial reason. :P

---

That's it for now! We still have some more Lore questions to answer in future posts, and if you have any burning Lore questions (or dev questions) that you want answered, drop them in a comment below, or send them to us on the [url=https://discord.com/invite/PcCAhEmnDN]Discord[/url]!

Until then, back to the dev mines.

notes.title: Vaygren Development Q&A #1
notes.content:
Thanks to everyone who sent in questions! We got A LOT, so we'll pick a handful for now, and save the rest for some regular Q&A posts. 

[h3][i]To start, in response to questions about future release dates:[/i][/h3]
Any answers we might give would just be guesses at best (and terrible ones, undoubtedly). So no more release dates until the game is done, polished, and uploaded to Steam and just going through final bug testing.

Now, for the rest of the questions…
For the moment, we'll leave the Vaygren Lore questions aside for the moment and answer some relating to the game.

[h1]Vaygren Development Q&A #1[/h1]
[b]Can you please keep the community updated going forward, so we all know that development is continuing and the game isn't dead?[/b]
Absolutely. We'll be doing at least a monthly status update, plus other posts like this Q&A, etc.

[b]How big is your team?[/b]
Though there are a few things that we outsource for the game (music, background art, etc), basically there are just two of us here doing the bulk of the work.
[list]
[*] Cyberunique - [i]Artist, Animator, and Art Director[/i]
[*] Aebard - [i]Director, Programmer, Editor, Sound Engineer, Live2D Rigger, Scene Layout, Sprite Poser & Animator, Scenario Writer, Art Cleanup, etc.[/i][/list]
[b]Are you considering adding any team members to speed up the process?[/b]
Oh, hell yes. At the very least, we'll be attempting to find some people that can tackle some of the things that Aebard currently handles (Live2D, Sound Engineer, Art Cleanup) so he can spend that time getting the next episode pulled together.

[b]Why is the episode being delayed so much?[/b]
Essentially, we drastically underestimated the amount of time certain aspects of the game's production takes (specifically, the scene layout + polish with the Live2D animations & Camera angles). And then we drastically underestimated it again. And then again.

 We're planning on doing some steam updates with some behind the scenes video of Episode 3, showing the process of creating the dialog scenes in Vaygren, and just how time consuming it is.

[b]What is the hardest part of making the game?[/b]
Making regular posts on Steam, Social Media, etc. >_< That stuff takes time, and sometimes we get tunnel vision working on the game that the update posts fall by the wayside.

[b]Can you give us any insight into how the voice actor auditioning and recording is done?[/b]
For Vaygren LT, we first did some character write ups with some rough art and sample dialog lines. We got back a bunch of auditions reading the sample lines, and made our selections based off of those.

As far as getting the lines recorded, we provided the VA's with the script, they'd record it, send it back to us, and we'd listen and see if anything needed adjustment. 

[b]Are any of the voice actors ones that we would recognize from other things?[/b]
All of our VA's have been in other projects. You should go check out the other things they've done!
[list]
[*] Nyx - [url=https://x.com/MidnightDatura]@MidnightDatura[/url]
[*] Solara - [url=https://x.com/Aife_thedarkelf]@Aife_thedarkelf[/url]
[*] Ra'Ga - [url=https://x.com/bakusatsuho]@bakusatsuho[/url]

[*] Queen Alees - [url=https://x.com/_VoiceLikeCandy]@_VoiceLikeCandy[/url][/list]
[b]Will you ever make a (strategy / RTS / RPG / Third Person / Etc) type of game for Vaygren?[/b]
It's definitely something we want to do at some point. We love visual novels, we can't deny that the Vaygren world is an excellent first for any number of type of games. We even have a few rough outlines of potential other types of games. But before all that, we have to finish Lustful Temptations.

[b]Will there be a Gallery? And will it include the non-H CGs and/or let us replay scenes?[/b]
Yes there will! You'll be able to view all CGs (that is, any traditionally drawn animations or CGs constructed from more than the regular sprites), AND you will also be able to jump to and replay sex scenes. 

[b]Will you also include recap for previous episodes for whose who havent replayed the game in a while since the last chapter?[/b]
Not in the initial release of the episode, but possibly later on as a QOL update. Implementing this at the moment would be a bit too time consuming at the moment.

[b]Will the game be translated into other languages? (if so, which ones?)[/b]
We absolutely want to get the game translated and released into other languages, although that really depends on how much it's going to cost. As to which languages, at least Chinese (we do see all those requests), and we personally think it'd be really cool to get it released in Japanese (since the game is anime-inspired). 

[b]How do you feel about the person who made the Russian translation for the game (in the steam guides on the community page?)[/b]
It's super cool they did that! 
Neither of us speak Russian so we don't know how accurate the translation is, but we hope it's letting some people enjoy the game that otherwise might have had trouble with the language barrier!

[b]What is that super cool opening song? Is it in japanese?[/b]
Yes it is in Japanese! The song is called "Inferiority" and was produced by Souichi Sakagami ([url=tandess.com]tandess.com[/url]) specifically for Vaygren! 

[b]Will there be any other gameplay elements, or is it just a visual novel?[/b]
As far as gameplay goes, Lustful Temptations is a traditional visual novel. Occasionally you are given choices that will change which route of the story you are going down, but there won't be anything like a battle system or mini games. 

[b]Will there be a [insert specific fetish] in future chapters?[/b]
Okay, lets speed run this set. There's a slight possibility we might add a scene or two that touches on some of these, but as plans currently stand:
[list]
[*] [i]Futa X Futa:[/i] At least 1
[*] [i]Impregnation:[/i] Not in LT
[*] [i]Footjobs:[/i] Not specifically
[*] [i]Sex Fighting For Domination:[/i] Not in LT. Ish.
[*] [i]Surprise Buttsex:[/i] Well, it won't exactly be a surprise…[/list]
[b]What if I can't get the game because it's not available in my region?[/b]
We're working on a solution for this, and are planning on launching the game on itch.io sometime after Episode 2 releases.

[h3]And finally, the most frequently asked question:[/h3]
[b]Why no balls?[/b]
Ah yes, the question of the century. Who knows. Possibly this is one of the unanswerable mysteries of the universe. 

[i]Or maybe it's because Cyberunique just really doesn't like drawing balls. [/i]

---

That's it for now! We'll do another post answering some more of the questions you sent us soon, and if you have any more questions you'd like to see us answer in one of these posts, drop them in the comments below or [url=https://discord.gg/PcCAhEmnDN]shoot us a message on discord[/url]!

Back to the game dev mines with us.

notes.title: Where Things Are At
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41960181/ab5810133e25d8af9aeac54ba3d7741ca10362e8.png[/img]
[h1]So... where are things at?[/h1]
Well, as it turns out, "a week or so" wound up more on the side of "or so"...

As for where things stand at the moment: we are very, very close. No dates, but once the final touches have been put on the episode, we'll let everyone know, and the update will drop within a day or two of the announcement. 

It won't be this week, thanks to the holiday here in the States, but it will be Soon. 

[h2]What's taking so long!? You said it'd just be a week![/h2]
That's fair...

The main reason? Things STILL took longer than we thought, which caused our schedules to run into other, pre-scheduled obligations in November, which made things take even LONGER, and so here we are.

Additionally, as we running through the game, there were parts that were just not up to the standards we wanted, so we added a couple still CGs and minor animations to get things to where we were happy with it.

[h2]A peek into the process...[/h2]
Just to give you all an idea (and for anyone who's interested in some of the behind the scenes info), here's a rough explanation of the "posing" stage and why it takes so long.

Vaygren makes HEAVY use of camera angels, posable 2d models, and animation. This is how we get the "watching an anime" feel to the game, and it's a lot of work to implement. We're not just switching between static sprites, we have to setup the scene, create the expressions, poses, make sure everything animates properly and is timed appropriately, etc, and then do it all again if it doesn't look right.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41960181/0806ddeaa4266f3dcca6d6cb8287ca422ee25dc7.png[/img]
Depending on the scene, this means 5 lines of dialog can take 2 or more hours to properly setup the poses, camera angles, and animations. A full scene can take days or weeks, depending on the complexity, and that's WITH the custom toolset we've built to speed things up.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41960181/075da984c3e78b20559d47a7071690c281d3bdb7.png[/img]
Once Episode 2 is out, we're planning on making a behind the scenes video showing some work on posing scenes for Episode 3.

[h1]So....[/h1]

As we said, we're very VERY close now. It won't be long.  
We are more active on [url=https://discord.gg/PcCAhEmnDN]Discord[/url] and always happy to answer questions about the game's development status or process. 

Going forward, once Episode 2 drops, what sort of information would you all like to see in posts regarding Episode 3's progress? Let us know!

notes.title: DELAYED?! WHAT THE $#@%!?
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41960181/3eb3962e91a1bb5514ebf56b3f117c4adee9bf37.png[/img]
[h1]Well, guys, we fucked up. [/h1]

Obviously, Episode 2 did not release today as expected. Nothing unexpected came up or got in the way, we simply underestimated the amount of work involved to get the episode to a state fit for release, and that's on us. We apologize to everyone who was waiting and had their hopes up.

There's just the two of us working full time on the game, and sometime we overestimate how much we can do and how quickly. This isn't an excuse, just an explanation, and it's something we know we need to get better at. 

All that said, Episode 2 is very close to being ready, but we are reluctant to give a concrete date considering our track record. It's not going to be a huge delay; we'll need a week or so at most to finish up testing, fixing a few technical issues, and putting on the polish. We'll keep everyone informed, and give a date once we are sure, beyond a doubt, that it's ready. Not "will be ready" but is ready.

Once again, we are very sorry for getting everyone's hopes up.
We'll do better.

notes.content:

[h3]The Vaygren - Lustful Temptation Codex![/h3]

As this game will be most people's introduction to the World of Vaygren, we knew from the beginning that we wanted to include an in-game encyclopedia to provide players with a way to learn more about the world. As different topics are mentioned in-game, the relevant entries will be unlocked in the codex, letting players read up on them and maybe... just [i]maybe[/i]... find some [i]spicy[/i] "bonus" images. 

We had planned to have this in the game at launch, buuuut like the CG and Scene Gallery, it got pushed back so we could make the release date. It's for the best though! This new design of the codex beats the old one, hands down!

notes.title: Development Update - 6/30
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41960181/324255a93abd54826adad7a7823dd34e3441ed87.png[/img]
It's been a month and some change since Vaygren - Lustful Temptation went into Early Access.

We were a little worried about only releasing episode 1, but the response you all so far has been amazing! We're so glad people recognize the effort we've been putting into the game.

[h3]So, the question on everyone's mind... when is Episode 2 coming?[/h3]

[b]We are cranking on Episode 2, and shooting for September.[/b] It's super important to us that Episode 2 meets the same standards as Episode 1, so we won't commit to a specific date until we're certain everything will be done. We don't want a repeat of last time. ^^;

Oh! We also finished some gameplay and characters & cast trailers. Ideally we'd have had these pre-launch... but that's just not what fate had in store for us. But they are done now! Please spread them around!

[previewyoutube=-4OklWJ-ukg;leftthumb][/previewyoutube][previewyoutube=HJBLugPQPiY;rightthumb][/previewyoutube]

[h2]So, what have we been working on?[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]Game Trailers[/b]
Please spread them around! Check them out on our [url=https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCx_-lmPpcf2kDMNeEgvIVAQ]YouTube Channel[/url]!
[*] [b]New Sprites[/b]
There are a handful of new characters showing up in Episode 2, all of whom need sprites! Their designs are done, so we're working on rigging their outfits and getting them game-ready!
[*] [b]Old Sprites[/b]
Now that the girls are on the road and traveling, they've got their traveling cloaks on, but... those cloaks cover up a bit too much. So we've given them an "open cloak" variation.
[*] [b]Animations[/b]
All the sex scenes in this chapter are now being animated, and are mostly done!
[*] [b]Finishers[/b]
Just like in Episode 1, each sex scene has a special "finisher" CG. Originally, we were going to have to cut these from Episode 2 because of time constraints... but now that we have the time, we're putting them back in!
[*] [b]Scene Layout[/b]
This one's a doozey, an the biggest time sink. This is where the whole game comes together, with the characters moving, posing, and all the various camera angles. Slow going on this one (partially since we can't finalize it until other assets are complete), but we're chipping away at it!
[/list]
[h2]What about the CG and Scene Gallery?[/h2]
We're still planning on releasing and update adding these in this PRIOR to Episode 2,  buuuut it's a lower priority than finishing the next episode. Worst case, it will come out with Episode 2.
--
Once again, thanks everyone for showing their support for the game. Glad to have you all with us on this journey with Nyx and her squad!

If you're interested in seeing some of the development yourself, pop into our streams on [url=Picarto.tv/Cyberunique]Picarto.tv/Cyberunique[/url] (or check the discord for stream notifications!) around 8:30 PM EST. 
[b]Beware, there will be spoilers for upcoming episodes![/b]
